sources.title: Free AI 3D Model Generator from Text & Images | Image to 3D AI
sources.snippet: Create production-ready 3D models from text or images with our free AI 3D model generator. Clean geometry, rich textures, and easy export for any project.

sources.title: Create 3D Models Online for Free with AI | Create3D.io
sources.snippet: Create3D.io is an AI 3D model generator and online 3D creation studio. With Create3D you can create 3D assets with AI from a text prompt, a reference image, or multiple views, then preview, refine, texture, repair, convert, and export downloadable 3D models for games, product design, 3D printing, AR, e-commerce, and creative projects.

sources.title: Free AI 3D Model Generator from Text & Images | AIto3D.ai
sources.snippet: AI 3D Model Generator from Text and Images Create downloadable 3D models from a text prompt, one image, or multiple reference views. With AIto3D.ai, you can generate a model online, inspect it in 3D, and export it for games, 3D printing, product design, web, or AR.

sources.title: Modly — Free Local AI 3D Model Generator | Open Source, Offline
sources.snippet: Turn any photo or text prompt into a 3D model with local AI. Export as GLB, OBJ, STL or PLY. Free, open source, runs entirely on your GPU — no cloud, no account.

sources.title: Sloyd · 3D AI Model Generator | Unlimited Generative 3D
sources.snippet: Unlimited AI 3D creation from text or images. Refine and control results without heavy manual 3D work — for game devs, designers, 3D printing.
